how_to_apply: Download the application form and notification PDF from the official website or use the provided link.
Read all terms, conditions, and instructions carefully before filling out the form.
Fill in the required details in the prescribed format and affix a passport-size photo on the application form.
Attach self-attested copies of all relevant certificates, mark sheets, and documents.
Submit the completed application form by post, courier service, or in person to the Principal Investigator.
Ensure the application reaches the designated address on or before 19/10/2026 up to 6.00 PM.

Postal Address: Principal Investigator, “Development of Innovative Framework for Carbon - Neutral Multifunctional Landscape Using Advanced Data Driven Tools”, Department of Soil & Water Conservation Engineering, Dr. A.S. College of Agricultural Engineering & Technology, Mahatma Phule Krishi Vidyapeeth, Rahuri, Dist: Ahmednagar-413722 (MS).
important_instructions: The positions are purely temporary and contractual on an ad-hoc research project basis initially for 6 months or until the termination of the project. Candidates must execute a bond-pond paper of Rs. 100/- stating terms and conditions are acceptable. The applicant must bring photo identity for verification during the document process or interview. Canvassing in any form will make the candidate ineligible. Selected candidates must devote full time to the assignment and cannot take up another appointment. The engagement will stand terminated on completion of the project or earlier without any responsibility for regularization by the University. Applicants must appear for the interview at their own cost when called. If leaving the job, the candidate must give one month's notice in writing or remit one month's salary.

faq.question: Q1. What is MPKV Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: MPKV Recruitment 2026 is an ad-hoc project notification to hire Senior Research Fellow (SRF) and Technical Assistant posts on a temporary basis.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in MPKV Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies available, divided into 1 vacancy for Senior Research Fellow and 1 for Technical Assistant.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for MPKV Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application is 19/10/2026 up to 6.00 PM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for MPKV Senior Research Fellow?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold an M. Tech/M.E. in Soil and Water Conservation Engineering, Land and Water Management Engineering, Water Resources Engineering, Irrigation and Drainage Engineering, or Irrigation Water Management Engineering.

faq.question: Q5. What is the upper age limit for MPKV posts?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 40 years for men and 45 years for women.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for MPKV Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for MPKV Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply by submitting the prescribed application form with self-attested documents by post, courier, or in person to the Principal Investigator.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary for MPKV Senior Research Fellow?
faq.answer: The Senior Research Fellow receives Rs. 37,000/- per month plus 10% HRA.

faq.question: Q9. When will the MPKV interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The date of the interview will be communicated separately to eligible candidates by email or text message.

faq.question: Q10. Are these permanent positions at MPKV?
faq.answer: No, these are purely temporary and contractual positions under an ad-hoc research project with no right to regularisation.
